card.name: Inside all-caps boxed warning titles
card.fires_on: The middle or final piece of a long medical word written in capital letters, inside an all-caps boxed warning heading. Examples are EMBRY|O, MYASTHEN|IA, AD|VERSE and ARTER|IAL.

modes.label: Split warning terms
modes.description: A capitalized warning term is split and this piece sits in the middle or end of it, with the rest of the term following.
modes.example: WARNING: CARDIOMYOPATHY, INFUSION REACTIONS, EMBRY<<O>>-FETAL TOXICITY,

modes.label: Other capitalized headings
modes.description: The same pattern appears in other all-caps label headings, such as drug names or conditions.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward more capital-letter word starts and away from capitalized programming terms like GET and DELETE.
card.plain: It marks the middle of a long capitalized word in a boxed warning headline, such as EMBRYO-FETAL or MYASTHENIA.
